content.comment_body: Hello everyone, happy new year! I found a [product_name] 230 RCL Type [article_no]. I tried programming it with [product_name] V5, and it works in simulation, but not on the actual device. I'm using count +/- blocks with a pulse block. In V5, the pulse goes through the +/- block, but on the hardware, it turns off after several pulses. I think I need [product_name] V3 to simulate it properly on my computer, but I can't find it online. Does anyone have it? Greetings, [user_name]
First, you need to select the correct [product_name] via Extra > Equipment Selection (or use CTRL+H), then you can create your program.

Hi! Please share your program. Also, keep in mind that older hardware versions are much slower than [article_no], so if you're using an input with a high frequency, the device may not register all counts. Older models could count up to 5Hz, while [article_no] can handle up to 2kHz on inputs I5 and I6. Hope this helps!

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters a discrepancy between simulation results in [product_name] V5 and actual performance on an older [product_name] hardware, where a pulse counting function works in software but fails on the device due to hardware limitations. The simulation does not accurately reflect the constraints of older hardware versions, leading to confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the simulation in [product_name] V5 to match the behavior of their older physical [product_name], and seeks [product_name] V3 to better simulate the device’s real capabilities.
